claim.name: M7-F canonical context-cache prefix audit
claim.primary_problem: DeepSeek 自动上下文缓存只命中完整匹配的已持久化 cache-prefix unit。CodeWhale 每个 ModelRequest 都在 canonical transcript 后临时追加 Host facts；下一轮 transcript 不含上一轮 Host facts，因此它不是上一轮 wire input + model output 的严格延伸，可能使同一 run 的缓存前缀推进落后一轮。
claim.acceptance: 用真实 AgentApplication -> AgentRuntime -> RunStore -> DeepSeek RequestPlan loopback 冻结逐请求消息、工具目录、system blocks、reasoning replay 与 SQLite reopen 身份；精确定位首个必要/非必要 break。只有不改变模型可见语义、freshness、evidence、权限、exact replay、billing truth 的 treatment 才可进入 live 准入。
claim.single_owner: crates/context owns prompt bytes and Host-fact projection; crates/deepseek owns exact Chat wire planning and usage parsing; AgentRuntime and RunStore own exact ModelRequest/event/replay truth.
claim.replacement: 没有通过全部语义与 replay 门禁的 treatment 不替代当前 projection。M7-F 不把 cache-control metadata、prompt hash 或离线最长公共前缀估算当成官方 cache hit。
claim.cutover_deletion: 若没有可归因 production wire delta，删除所有实验性 production branch，只保留协议合同测试、离线 manifest/result 与结论；不读取 Key、不调用官方 API。

rules.enabled: automatic for every user without a manual cache API
rules.match: a hit requires a full match of an already persisted cache-prefix unit
persistence: a common prefix detected across requests
fixed token intervals for long inputs or outputs
rules.retention: usually hours to days and not guaranteed

block_order: stable constitution: base prompt + project context + user constitution + optional project pack + output discipline + skills + fixed Simplified Chinese contract
system_prompt.wire_fact: crates/deepseek joins every block into one system message with a fixed separator; PromptCacheControl is not a provider field and creates no physical wire cache boundary.

messages.history: ContextBroker projects canonical transcript entries in order and preserves complete reasoning/tool groups.
messages.host_facts: task generation, acceptance IDs, workspace generation/revision, current receipt and unresolved completion/verifier facts are rendered as the final user message of every request.
messages.provenance: the Host-facts tail has no canonical transcript index and is not replayed as history in the next request.
messages.reasoning: assistant reasoning_content and raw tool arguments are replayed exactly when required by DeepSeek.

tools.order: fixed production definitions are prefix-stable and alphabetical
tools.planner: the exact canonical catalog is persisted in ModelRequestPrepared and deterministically rebuilt after SQLite reopen

offline_matrix.fact: same root, same system, same catalog, unchanged workspace, two read-only tool turns
offline_matrix.measure: whether request N+1 is an exact extension of request N input plus committed assistant/tool output; first differing message and UTF-8 boundary
the revision delta must remain in the latest Host-facts tail and must not move before canonical history

offline_matrix.fact: failed verifier, later edit, later pass and EvidenceReceipt
offline_matrix.measure: fresh rejection/failure/receipt facts remain visible and latest-revision completion stays fail closed

offline_matrix.fact: same task and same absolute workspace, distinct Host generation/run identity
offline_matrix.measure: first semantic break after exact task_generation normalization; raw identity remains distinct

offline_matrix.fact: same fixture bytes in different canonical absolute workspace slots
offline_matrix.measure: workspace revision and any system/project-context differences are not normalized away

offline_matrix.fact: root, read-only child, explicit isolated Writer and terminal empty catalog
offline_matrix.measure: role prompt/catalog differences are intentional authority boundaries, not cache defects

offline_matrix.fact: hard-limit local projection keeps mandatory task, mutation and evidence facts
offline_matrix.measure: compaction is an intentional semantic context delta and exact projection digest survives replay

offline_matrix.fact: same prepared request retry and SQLite/process reopen
offline_matrix.measure: attempt changes do not mutate exact messages/system/tools; uncertain side effects do not replay writes

offline_matrix.fact: assistant reasoning, multiple tool calls and deferred child handoff
offline_matrix.measure: no cache treatment may reorder or drop required DeepSeek reasoning/tool adjacency
no cache optimization manufactures a workspace mutation, receipt or false completion

measurement.authoritative_input: persisted ModelRequestPrepared plus deterministic crates/deepseek RequestPlan; raw HTTP loopback body must equal the rebuilt plan
prefix_levels: common UTF-8 bytes within equal-role text
non_claims: UTF-8 common bytes are not DeepSeek tokenizer tokens
a common prefix is not a cache hit until the provider reports prompt_cache_hit_tokens
PromptCacheControl metadata is not sent to DeepSeek
body JSON key order is not assumed to be the provider cache key
best-effort cache retention prevents treating a single miss as a deterministic regression

required_before_production_code: a named non-essential first break with an exact production caller
a wire delta visible in RequestPlan and raw loopback HTTP
byte-for-byte preservation of every model-visible semantic fact modulo explicitly approved order
exact reasoning/tool replay and crash/reopen equivalence
no second Runtime, Store, request truth, tool directory, model loop or product mode
forbidden_shortcuts: moving dynamic Host facts earlier in the prompt
dropping workspace revision, receipt, verifier failure or completion rejection
persisting stale Host facts as ordinary user instructions without a typed supersession contract
splitting system messages based on generic OpenAI assumptions
reordering tool schemas when the official cache key treatment is unspecified
using aggregate historical cache ratios as a same-binary treatment result

decision_threshold.efficiency: At least one of cache-hit input, total input, requests, wall time or cost improves stably without a hidden transfer cost.
decision_threshold.complexity: Any added state or code must be explained by a concrete break and deleted if the wire/metric gain is absent.
